name: Tawilla (T56 C1-5) 2 BDR
headline: Eclectic 2 BDR Twin House @ Tawila El Gouna
summary: This Eclectic 2 bedroom twin house sleeps 7 guests and is located at Gouna's elite community of Tawila. The twin house features a private roof top jacuzzi in addition to a large terrace and is managed by Xuru Stays

description.Space:
This lagoon front 2 bedroom twin house is located in Gouna's beloved Tawila community. 

The ground level features an open plan fully equipped kitchen, ensuite bedroom and a living room with a sofa bed overlooking the lagoon. 

It also features a 65 inch smart TV with Airplay and cable channels, washing machine, a Nespresso machine, kettle and a microwave. 

The upper floor includes a the second bedroom which sleeps 3 guests and has its own private bathroom. 

The twin house also features a large terrace with a private jacuzzi and a nice seating area overlooking the lagoons of Tawila. 


The styling of the villa is tailored to give the guests a relaxing and a unique vibe.


At Xuru Stays, we’re committed to providing our guests the magical hospitality they deserve.
description.Access: Guests have access to the entire property
description.Interaction:
We are more than happy to answer all of your questions 24/7. Guests can text and call anytime they need help and our team will be there in about 30 mins to solve any issue immediately.

At Xuru Stays, we’re committed to providing our guests the magical hospitality they deserve.
description.Neighborhood:
-Tawila is uniquely located 400 meters from Gourmet (grocery store). Guests will be able to walk 5 minutes and get to it. 
- Abu Tig Marina is a 4 minute drive from Tawila (features many restaurants, cafes and bars)
description.Transit:
Free outdoor parking is available. 
Tuktuks are available to take you anywhere in El Gouna (flat fee).
description.Notes: Please note that smoking is not allowed inside the apartment. A fine of $100 may be imposed in case of smoking indoors.

agreement:
• Kindly note that a damage deposit of USD 150 (or the equivalent in EGP) is required. The payment is collected online as part of the reservation payment and will be reimbursed on the checkout day, provided no damages are incurred.
  • Smoking (including shisha) inside the unit is strictly not allowed. However it is allowed in the unit’s balcony (if applicable). A fine of $100 may be imposed in case of smoking indoors.
 • Partying, excessive noise and public alcohol drinking is not allowed. In case of violations, security will be notified and appropriate strict actions will be taken. 
 • Visitors are not allowed, only confirmed guests stated in the reservation will be granted entry. 
• Egyptian & Arab couples ONLY are required to provide proof of marriage according to Egyptian law. Guests are required to send their IDs or passports to the email (id@xurustays.com) or (id.elgouna@xurustays.com) as per the local regulations.
• El Gouna entry permits require 48 hours to be issued, in case guest IDs and passports are sent less than 48 hours before check in date, entry permits are subject to delay or may not be granted. (In case of disapproval from community security office, guests will be fully refunded).
 • Cancellation more than 30 days before the arrival date, we keep 10% of the total price of the stay.
 • Cancellation between 15 days and 30 days before the arrival date, we keep 50% of the total price of the stay. 
• Cancellation between 7 days and 15 days before the arrival date, we keep 75% of the total price of the stay.
• Less than 7 days, we keep 100% of the price of the stay
• Pets are not allowed, in case of violation, Xuru Stays has the right to cancel the reservation with no refund. 


Thank you for choosing our home for your Holiday.
We hope that you have a pleasant stay.

Xuru Stays

This is the 3rd time I write a review and somehow AirBnb lost the other 2, but I insist to let others know how great this place is. The location is perfect, 6-8 minutes away from the 2 shopping areas of Elgouna and just steps away from Gourmet supermarket. The unit itself is amazing with classy modern decor and top quality furniture, specially the bedding and mattresses. The rooftop is great for spending evenings when it’s not hot, and the high ceiling air conditioned living room is a nice refuge for midday when it’s too hot. There is a smart TV with very good internet that I used to stream on both the TV and phones without any lag. There is a lot to do outside as well, a pool downstairs, beaches, scuba diving and kite surfing. 

The property is managed by a very professional hospitality company called Xuru Stays, who were the best in all my years in AirBnb. They have a team on the ground and a very responsive customer service center. They do whatever it takes to resolve any issues.
